title.narrative: Water as Leverage Cartagena – Construyendo con el agua: Team ‘Raíces de Cartagena’

description.narrative: The programme “Water as Leverage Cartagena – Construyendo con el agua” has successfully completed Phase 2. The two multidisciplinary teams have delivered prefeasibility studies for a total of five projects that aim to strengthen the city’s climate adaptation, improve water management, and promote nature-based solutions. The multidisciplinary team ‘Raíces de Cartagena’ has worked on the project “Mamonal Drainage – Bay of Cartagena” and the project “Canal Zone”. Together with the other multidisciplinary team (ref. PIPP23CO02), the project “Juan Angola Canal” has been delivered. The prefeasibility studies are available for download.These projects were co-created by national and international experts, together with the Municipality of Cartagena, local communities, public institutions, and private sector representatives, in a participatory process that has been key to aligning the proposed solutions with the real needs of the territory. The initiatives include urban interventions with the potential to reduce flood risks, restore ecosystems around water bodies, and create opportunities for sustainable development.With the delivery of these results, the program now moves into its next phase, which will focus on feasibility studies and financial structuring. Following a technical and strategic evaluation process, the area of the Juan Angola Canal has already been selected to develop a feasibility-level project within the framework of the WaL Program by the multidisciplinary team “Raíces de Cartagena”, building on progress already made by the Infrastructure Secretariat. This project represents a key opportunity to integrate comprehensive solutions for water management, environmental restoration, and sustainable urban development.The Phase 2 results of the other WaL Cartagena projects will serve as inputs to prepare further resilience actions in the city, such as hydrological and environmental improvements in the Ciénaga de la Virgen, or the definition of other long-term interventions in Cartagena and its surroundings.WaL Cartagena will continue its efforts to promote sustainable development and explore opportunities to generate impact based on these results.The Water as Leverage Cartagena Program is led by the Government of the Netherlands, in partnership with the Municipality of Cartagena and various local and national actors. It is carried out within a long-term vision to strengthen urban resilience in the face of climate change.The multidisciplinary team ‘Raíces de Cartagena’ is led by Witteveen+Bos and includes the consortium members Felixx Landscape Architects & Planners, Aqua & Terra, Universidad de Cartagena, CSC Strategy & Finance.
